final: SELECT o.orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount), COUNT(e.fillcount), COUNT(e.fillcount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(group_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(e2.fillcount) AS group_count FROM orderexecutions e2 JOIN orders o2 ON e2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault GROUP BY o2.orderflow)) FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow
